title: Whole Life Insurance Policy Values Card: Accumulation Rate, Dividend Option Default and Service Minimums
content:
Each Ashgrove tier of Whole Life Insurance has its own declared annual interest rate on dividend accumulations, dividend option applied when the owner made no election, smallest partial surrender of paid-up additions and smallest withdrawal from dividend accumulations; the federal withholding rate on the taxable part of a distribution and the longest deferral of a cash surrender payment are common to all tiers.

| Tier | Dividend accumulation rate (annual, credited on each anniversary) | Dividend option when none was elected | Smallest partial surrender of paid-up additions (USD of cash value) | Smallest withdrawal from accumulations, unless the whole balance is withdrawn (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | 0% (0.0) | None (non-participating) | 0 | 0 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | 3.75% (0.0375) | Paid-up additions | 250 | 100 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | 3.75% (0.0375) | Paid-up additions | 250 | 100 |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | 3.75% (0.0375) | Paid-up additions | 250 | 100 |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | 3.75% (0.0375) | Paid-up additions | 250 | 100 |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | 3.75% (0.0375) | Paid-up additions | 250 | 100 |

| Figure (every tier) | Value |
|---|---|
| Federal income tax withheld from the taxable portion of a distribution, unless the owner elects no withholding | 10% (0.1) |
| Longest deferral of a cash surrender payment under the deferral clause | 180 calendar days |

## Applying the card (hypothetical requests)

- A withdrawal of 100 dollars from accumulations on a 20-Pay policy meets the minimum; a withdrawal of 60 dollars meets it only where it takes the whole balance.
- A partial surrender of paid-up additions for 250 dollars of cash value meets the minimum on a Paid-Up at 65 policy; 200 dollars does not.
- On a taxable portion of 3000.00 dollars, withholding at 10% is 300.00 dollars, unless the owner elected no withholding.
